program.section_heading: Energy Management and Auditing Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to evaluate the principles that relate to California Title 24; energy conservation through residential & commercial building energy auditing.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to evaluate and understand energy inefficiencies in HVAC systems and duct work.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify, analyze, and evaluate common types of energy management systems.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze and evaluate various control schemes of energy management systems.
